note: The four questions used. Ground truth computed by eval/ground_truth.py in Python DuckDB over raw Parquet, not the app views. Frozen: sha256 of the full eval/questions.json (13 questions) is in results/questions.sha256 and is checked by the runner.
green_flag_definition: For bahrain_clean_pace: laps rows with session='R', race='bahrain_grand_prix', Driver in ('VER','NOR'), TrackStatus exactly '1' (no other status code at any time during the lap), LapTime not null, PitInTime null (not an in-lap), PitOutTime null (not an out-lap), Deleted not true. Median of an even count is the mean of the two middle laps.
python_output_bahrain_clean_pace: [('VER', 95477000000.0, 49), ('NOR', 96536500000.0, 48)]  (Driver, median LapTime in ns, laps used). Verstappen 95.477 s = 1:35.477; Norris 96.5365 s (1:36.5365; the scorer displays 1:36.537).

questions.question: Which team won the most races in 2024, and how many?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT TeamName, count(*) FROM results WHERE session='R' AND Position=1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: Which tyre compound was used for the most race laps in 2024?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT Compound, count(*) FROM laps WHERE session='R' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: In the 2024 Bahrain Grand Prix, who had the faster race pace, Verstappen or Norris? Use only green-flag laps, excluding in-laps, out-laps and deleted laps. Give the median lap time for each.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT Driver, median(LapTime) AS median_ns, count(*) AS laps_used FROM laps WHERE session='R' AND race='bahrain_grand_prix' AND Driver IN ('VER','NOR') AND TrackStatus='1' AND LapTime IS NOT NULL AND PitInTime IS NULL AND PitOutTime IS NULL AND coalesce(Deleted, false) = false GROUP BY Driver ORDER BY median_ns
questions.expected: faster driver=Verstappen/VER/Max Verstappen, median lap NOR=1:36.537 (96.537s), median lap VER=1:35.477 (95.477s)

questions.question: Who won the 2023 Monaco Grand Prix?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM results WHERE season <> 2024
questions.expected: Refuse: the data covers the 2024 season only; name no driver.
